deferred.claim: Cast Jeskai Revelation: return a targeted spell or permanent, deal 4 damage to any target, create two Monk tokens with prowess, draw two cards, and gain 4 life.
deferred.basis: Return target spell or permanent to its owner's hand. Jeskai Revelation deals 4 damage to any target. Create two 1/1 white Monk creature tokens with prowess. Draw two cards. You gain 4 life.
